about_the_game:
ForgeRun is a fast-paced co-op arena survival game where anyone can become a hero. Battle endless swarms of enemies, gather items and augments, and earn powerful weapons mid-fight to survive as long as you can.

Every run, you’ll face waves of enemies, each more relentless than the last. Smash through them, collect gold, and charge totems to create random items that permanently change your build.

Key Features

  • Improve Your Build – Charge totems on the battlefield to earn random weapons and abilities on the fly.

  • Co-op Chaos – Team up with friends and forge your own builds together as you fight off massive hordes.

  • Swarm Survival – Battle diverse enemy factions like Goblins, Ice Creatures, and Desert Robots in increasingly chaotic arenas.

  • Gold & Glory – Earn gold from kills to progress through new stages and roll for better items.

Will your team stand the test of the horde… or be crushed by their overwhelming numbers?

content_descriptors.notes:
ForgeRun contains cartoonish fantasy violence and combat against enemy creatures such as goblins, pirates, and undead. Enemies are defeated through stylized attacks, particle effects, and light impact animations.
There are no depictions of realistic gore, sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. The tone is lighthearted and arcade-style, not realistic or graphic.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4,096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: Low-poly art style and optimized assets — runs well on most modern laptops and desktops.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8,192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: None
